text:
sarah_cx: Heads up — Acme's production app is failing to parse our structured JSON responses. They get a SyntaxError when doing JSON.parse on the API response. Example stack: SyntaxError: Unexpected token \u2028 in JSON at position 123

sarah_cx: Raw response body (from our ingress logs):
```json
{"id":"resp_01GZ4X","model":"redwood-instruct-1","output":"{\"user\":\"O'Reilly\",\"bio\":\"Loves C:\\\\nNewlines and \\\"quotes\\\"\",\"notes\":\"Line separator:\\u2028here\",\"emoji\":\"\\uD83D\\uDE03\"}"}
```

sarah_cx: When the client does JSON.parse(body).output they get a string with embedded backslashes; their fast-json-parse later fails because of a raw U+2028 (line separator) present inside the inner JSON. The customer app only does one parse, expecting an object, so it hits type errors.

omar_support: Can you paste request id from the customer and a curl we can run to repro?

sarah_cx: Request id: req_01GZ4X. Repro curl:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-instruct-1","mode":"structured","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"user":{"type":"string"},"bio":{"type":"string"},"notes":{"type":"string"}}},"prompt":"give profile with name, bio, notes"}'
```

luca_ml: Likely double-stringify in the response path — either the model returns a JSON string (which is valid) and our response wrapper stringifies that again, or the client only JSON.parse's once. Quick debug in node:
```js
const res = /* raw body from API */;
const parsed = JSON.parse(res);
console.log(typeof parsed.output); // if 'string' => needs second parse (JSON.parse(parsed.output))
```

luca_ml: Also note U+2028 (line separator) is valid in JSON only if escaped as \\u2028; an unescaped raw U+2028 inside a JS string literal will break some runtimes or embedding strategies. JSON.parse accepts escaped \\u2028 but not a literal line separator character in a source literal.

jess_prod: Short-term workaround: set "response_format":"raw_json" on the endpoint (we have a flag) so the platform won't stringify the structured output. Omar — can you enable for the customer and see if it fixes?

omar_support: Will enable raw_json for req_01GZ4X and DM the customer. Also logging note: I saw model version redwood-instruct-1@2026-02-11 in the logs.

infra_bot: Log snippet for req_01GZ4X: status=200 latency_ms=312 layer=response-wrapper action=stringify_out reason="structured output wrapped" link=https://internal/logs/resp_01GZ4X

sarah_cx: Thanks — customer confirmed they can parse after raw_json toggle. Will follow up with eng-ml to fix default behavior and add tests for double-escaping and U+2028 emission.

omar_support: Assigning to @luca_ml to add a regression test. :white_check_mark:
